notes.title: Update: The fae guard their gold...
notes.content:
The fair folk play by their own rules - Robin can no longer give gold freely in order to gain renown.

And a couple other typos and image fixes. Thanks to all the merry men and women who've reported bugs or questioned the game design. Keep it coming!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34977447/3ef4a647d9e892c5471fa4e29fab5ea13f4127bd.jpg[/img]
